item.tib: brag btsan dmar po'i srog bsgrub
item.coloph: mngon spyod bsgrabs (sgrab) pa'i cha lags su (lag tu/)rig 'dzin stong rgyang mthu chen gyis/ jo bo brag btsan dmar po yis (yi/)srog gi bsgrub (sgrub) pa 'di nyid gsungs/ rdo rje rtsal la snyan du brgyud/ phyi rab (rabs) las ldan cig (gcig) la sprod/ de phyir cig (gcig) brgyud sa ma ya//

item.tib: brag btsan dmar po'i srogs bsgrubs
item.coloph: rig 'dzin bsgrubs (sgrub) pa'i cha lag tu/ rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyis// jo bo brag btsan dmar po'i/ srog gis bsgrubs (gi sgrub) pa 'di nyid gsungs/ rdo rje rtsal la snyan du brgyud/ phyi rab (rabs) las ldan cig la sprod/ de phyir gcig brgyud sa ma ya/ dkar chab (chag) yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol/ bka' skyong srungs ma'i (srung mas) bka' chad ma btang gtong zhig bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod par shog/
